title: Decoding Sensor Frame using Union
description:
Sensor telemetry commonly transmits packed measurements over I2C or SPI as 4-byte payloads.

### Payload Layout (Big-Endian):
- Bytes [0..1]: Signed 16-bit integer representing temperature in 0.1°C units.
- Bytes [2..3]: Unsigned 16-bit integer representing relative humidity in 0.1% units.

### Requirements:
Implement `parse_sensor_word` properly handling signed two's complement decoding for negative temperatures.
hint: Be careful when casting signed values: construct the 16-bit word unsigned first, then cast to `int16_t` so sign extension is properly preserved.
